# Ancient China Travel
> Step-by-step guides to visit ancient Chinese archaeological sites. Ticket prices, museum booking instructions, and itineraries for foreign travelers. Single-page guide.

## Site
- [Home — Walk Through 5,000 Years](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/): Every archaeological site, prices, hours, and routes in one page
- [About](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/about/): Who writes this site and how the information is verified
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/privacy/): How visitor data is handled
- [Terms of Use](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/terms/): Terms for using the content

## Sections
- [Ancient Sites You Can Walk Through](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#sites): 8 sites — Dawenkou, Liangzhu, Sanxingdui, Yin Xu, Terracotta Warriors, Han Yangling, Mawangdui, Qianling
- [Every Site at a Glance](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#compare): Comparison table of era, culture, tickets, hours, and visit time
- [How to Visit Each Site](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#site-guides): Getting there, where to eat, and pro tips per site
- [Ready-Made Itineraries](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#routes): 10-day, Xi'an & Chengdu, and Henan archaeology tours
- [Practical Essentials](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#practical): Booking tickets, 240-hour visa, high-speed rail, SIM cards, tour guides
- [Best Time to Visit](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#best-time): Season-by-season guidance for all sites
- [Money & Payments](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#money): Alipay, WeChat Pay, cash, and cards for foreign travelers
- [Survival Mandarin](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#phrases): Eight essential phrases for tickets, taxis, and toilets
- [Before You Go Checklist](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#checklist): Packing and prep for the trip
- [Interactive Map](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#map): All eight sites on one map
- [FAQ](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#faq): Common traveler questions answered
- [Sources & Further Reading](https://www.5000-year-old-chinese-tomb.com/#sources): Authoritative references for site facts

## Key Facts
- Oldest site: Dawenkou (6,300 years), free entry
- UNESCO sites: Liangzhu (2019), Yin Xu (2006), Terracotta Warriors (1987)
- Most tickets bookable via WeChat mini-programs with a foreign passport
- China's 240-hour visa-free transit covers gateway cities Hangzhou, Chengdu, and Xi'an
